gaps: P0–P4: no candidates. P5 has only the 1918 air photo.
notes: #2 is low resolution (1187 px wide) and no single landmark stands out. #1 is the same 1918 survey as a pasted mosaic covered with handwritten labels. #4 shows the Antonivka end of the city, not the historic center; the bridge was destroyed in 2022. #6 (2019 drone view of the TV tower) is the alternative for P6.
